title: Preservation of property testing
statement: Let $n$ be positive, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction be given for a Boolean PCPP verifier. If the verifier is a probabilistically checkable proof system for a property $P$ of Boolean words of length $n$ at rate $r_0>0$—meaning every word in $P$ has a proof accepted with probability one, and every word at relative Hamming distance greater than $�$epsilon from every word in $P$ is rejected with probability greater than $r_0�$epsilon for all $0\leq\epsilon\leq1$ and every proof—then the composed three-query verifier is a PCPP for $P$ at rate $r_0/K$, where $K$ is the reduction's positive clause count.
